rules.statement: A reissued writ does not terminate the authority of a previous seizure and a fresh seizure is not necessary after the death of an execution-debtor if the property was under attachment at the time of death.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiff sought to meet this by arguing that the seizure on March 11, 1924, terminated when the Fiscal returned the writ on June 6,1924, and that the reissue of the writ with fresh stamps was a fresh mandate to the Fiscal, that the seizure under the first issue of writ had ceased to be effective, that a fresh seizure was necessary and as this would be after the death of Kiri Menika the appointment of a legal representative was necessary. But these are all matters on which there is clear authority."
